answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network couples cryptographic stake burning with superlinear cost scaling: an agent must burn tokenized stake proportional to the square of its concurrent identities ($O(N^2)$). Like a juniper root anchoring soil, this economic friction enforces quadratic capital loss on attackers. A verifiable lantern beacon anchors each identity, ensuring only a valid transaction signal propagates while making clone generation exponentially prohibitive.
